text: [image: 603 Forward Action Logo] 603 Forward 603 Forward is an organization dedicated to supporting young and new faces stepping up and running for office in NH. I am very happy to be endorsed, supported, and recieved training from their team.

[image: Forward Party and Young Forwardists logo] Forward Party & Young Forwardists I'm extremely proud to have the endorsement of THE leading pro-common sense compromise seeking and pro-government reform political organization nationwide.

[image: Mental Health Candidate 2026 certification by Mental Health Now] Certified Mental Health 2026 Candidate I am proud to be certified* as a Mental Health Now pro-mental health action candidate who will tackle the mental health crisis in the state. *Certification, not endorsement

[image: NH AFL-CIO Logo] NH AFL-CIO I'm extremely proud to accept the endorsement of THE LARGEST union federation in the nation, the AFL-CIO. I worked as a union organizer for their community affiliate, and I am proud to carry their banner in this fight. I will fight for workers every single day in Concord.

[image: New Hampshire Youth Movment Action Fund Circle Logo] NH Youth Movement The New Hampshire Youth Movement is the largest organization that seeks to specifically advocate for the needs of the youth of NH, who are absolutely CRITICAL to sustaining a good economy long-term. I am extremely proud to accept their endorsement.
[image]JJ DeFeo for Fremont NH State House District RO-7
